Keep both frozen bests, especially g0 at 0.830198, as utility controls. Source costs are 33,022,405/32,115,012 parameters and 37.64/33.07 inference seconds; current factorial trials took 844-856 seconds each. Within 19,887.5 remaining seconds, reserve resources for source replacement/factorial controls, matched capacity, measured training/inference cost, repetition, and frozen assessment. Failure to exceed g0, or an advantage explained by capacity/cost, opposes added utility. Compact single-seed summaries do not establish mechanisms or novelty; implementation details remain uninspected.

topic.title: Compatibility of representation construction and sequence-field interaction
topic.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, does combining the committed g0 representation approach with the g1 interaction approach improve validation four-task macro ROC-AUC over both frozen source bests, particularly g0 at 0.8301982212762624, at justified parameter and measured compute cost?
topic.hypothesis: Inherit the two committed source approaches, subject to implementation inspection in the next phase. The adaptive/uniform and rotation contrast observed in g1 may retain useful information on g0's stronger representation, but representation changes may already capture that information or introduce interference. Source replacement/factorial and matched-capacity controls, followed by repetition, must distinguish complementary utility from extra capacity and optimization effects. A repeatable gain over both frozen source bests with justified measured cost would support compatibility; failure to exceed the stronger source, or gains reproduced by capacity controls, would oppose added utility for the tested implementation. Source gains are not additive, and repeated seeds alone do not identify a mechanism. Use validation for selection, then freeze the comparison suite before one withheld assessment; do not use withheld outcomes to revise the topic.
